Calculate Tajima's D, pi, and Watterson's theta

Source: R/calculate_pi_theta_d.R
calculate_pi_theta_d.Rd

Calculates Tajima's D, nucleotide diversity (pi), and Watterson's theta from a biallelic genotype matrix, following the approach of Korunes & Samuk (2021) to account for missing data.

Monomorphic sites are removed before calculation, and raw_pi and watterson_theta are sums over segregating sites. They are not per-site (per-nucleotide) values, which would require the number of invariant sites sequenced; this information is unavailable for many reduced-representation datasets, and monomorphic SNP loci alone do not provide it. Tajima's D does not depend on invariant sites.

Usage

calculate_pi_theta_d(gt)

Arguments

gt

Genotype matrix where individuals are rows and loci are columns, coded as 0=aa, 1=aA, 2=AA.

Value

A list with elements:

tajima_d

Tajima's D statistic

num_sites

Number of segregating sites

raw_pi

Nucleotide diversity (pi) summed over segregating sites

watterson_theta

Watterson's theta summed over segregating sites

d_stdev

Standard deviation of the denominator

References

Korunes, K. L., & Samuk, K. (2021). pixy: Unbiased estimation of nucleotide diversity and divergence in the presence of missing data. Molecular Ecology Resources, 21(4), 1359–1368. https://doi.org/10.1111/1755-0998.13326

Tajima, F. (1989). Statistical method for testing the neutral mutation hypothesis by DNA polymorphism. Genetics, 123(3), 585–595. https://doi.org/10.1093/genetics/123.3.585
